statement: If a token is a COMMON NOUN in treebank-register text, then its single-token ablation record (85-d slot signature plus 19-d atmosphere, read by the three prior-free readers) ranks it above frequency-matched ordinary tokens even when pairs are matched on within-sentence position, and it beats position/length/mention-count covariates (position-matched AUC 0.579 vs covariates 0.451); the readers hear the noun's ROLE, and no comparable signal exists for proper nouns.
scope: UD DEV of 19 languages (position-matched subset; 20 unmatched), ant-kinds-ud's records (120 NOUN pairs per language before matching, frequency-bin matched), ridge-logistic PROBE leave-position-block-out, tested by ant-adversary's covariate attack; 17 of 19 languages have the signature above the covariates.
outOfScope: PROPN: unmatched 0.573 vs covariates 0.554 (+0.036 [0.000, 0.075]), position-matched 0.454 vs 0.462 (+0.006 [-0.083, +0.085]), i.e. nothing beyond position. Position-matched subsets are small (about 45-57 pairs per language), controls were matched on frequency bin only, character length >= 3 (the reader's figure floor) was NOT matched in these records, so a short-function-word control leak is not excluded for UD. No held-out fold, no informal English, not pre-registered as a replacement verdict (it is an attack on ant-kinds-ud's K3). In UD a proper noun leaves a SMALLER shadow than matched common words (extent AUC mean 0.453 by tokens, 0.439 by frames; frames below 0.45 in 14 of 22 languages).
observables: Ablate one token, re-read the prefix window, take typed slot deltas (emptied, retyped, rebound, refilled, shifted, born) as the record; covariates are token index, relative index, sentence length, initial flag, log mentions in window, log position. No capital, prior or list; gold UPOS only selects the NOUN stratum and the evaluation.
discovery: ant-adversary results/ud_confound.json (aggregate, recomputed in verify-signals.json): NOUN all 20 languages signature 0.577 vs covariates 0.518, increment +0.070 [0.043, 0.098], signature beats covariates in 15 and increment > 0 in 17; NOUN position-matched 19 languages signature 0.579 vs covariates 0.451, signature+covariates 0.574, increment +0.123 [0.081, 0.171] (language bootstrap), beats covariates in 17 of 19, increment > 0 in 18. Companion: ant-kinds-ud reports pooled signature AUC 0.59 for PROPN-vs-controls and K3 falsified 0/17. effect = position-matched NOUN signature AUC. Discovery on DEV only.
passIf: On fold80B (first 20% of the TRAIN treebanks) with character-length >= 3, position and mention count matched: NOUN signature AUC >= 0.55 with increment over covariates >= +0.05 in >= 12 of 16 languages.
failIf: Increment over covariates <= +0.02 once character length, position and mention count are all matched, or the signature is not above its label-permutation q95.

statement: If a stream is large (about 10^5 tokens or more: IRC 782k, a novel), then company-induced kinds (spherical k-means on before/after neighbour-count vectors, no tags) are reproducible on held-out days or book halves and are not frequency bands, but they are coarse POS-like frame classes: persons do NOT get their own kind, and conditioning a model on kind does not reveal a hidden name signal.
scope: IRC (24 kinds; held-out transfer to 17 unused channel-days), War and Peace (12 kinds), Pride and Prejudice (6), UD DEV of 19 languages (K* median 3, 2-12; function words, pronoun/aux/verb forms, nominal forms), enron (6); in UD, noun kinds separate place from institution where they exist (spa, hin, arb).
outOfScope: K1 as REGISTERED fails: IRC half-split gap 0.030 at K*=24 (< 0.10; the shuffled-company null is as stable as the real partition at every K <= 8), UD first batch 6 of 10 (needed 80%; all 19: 15 = 79%; the post-hoc amendment A1 'best margin above all 10 shuffled maxima' holds 19/19), P&P halves ARI 0.150 < 0.25, SMS gap 0.098 and cosem 0.071 (K*=16). No proper-noun-majority kind in any of 19 UD languages (max PROPN share in a kind: hin 0.33, spa 0.23, rus 0.18, eng 0.18). War and Peace: 49 of 62 cast forms sit in ONE kind with pronouns/determiners/conjunctions (the subject-position kind, 37% of tokens); places, titles, nationalities in the plain-noun kind. Kind labels are induced on the whole stream (non-causal) while reading is causal. Kind-conditioning (K3/Simpson): refuted, UD 0/17 (kind-conditioned minus pooled-plus-kind-feature -0.077; 0 sign reversals in 19 languages), novel matched-in-kind control -0.17 [-0.44, 0.05]; family-specific kind structure (K4) not supported (3-cluster -0.007, p 0.62; 2-family +0.030, p 0.079 with frequency-band control +0.022). K2: kinds differ in signature from random same-size partitions only slightly (IRC J1 +0.038 DEV, +0.009 CONF; novels J4 fails).
observables: Neighbour-token count vectors (sqrt, L2, PCA 48, spherical k-means), K by split-half ARI against a within-sentence-shuffled null; mention floor 3-8. No tags, capitals, priors or lists; gold only describes kinds afterwards.
discovery: ant-kinds-chat results/induce.irc.json (recomputed): K*=24, gap 0.0302, NMI(kind, frequency decile) 0.2397, held-out transfer ARI 0.4739 vs shuffled null 0.091-0.097 (re-induction vs transferred 0.511 vs 0.15-0.18); ant-kinds-novel War and Peace: 12 kinds vs 1 on shuffled text, halves ARI 0.594 vs null max 0.046, NMI vs frequency bin 0.047; ant-kinds-ud: NMI vs frequency bands median 0.008-0.01, NMI vs UPOS 0.23-0.25 vs 0.09-0.10 for shuffled-company kinds, observed best margin above all 10 shuffled maxima in 19/19 (post-hoc rule). Kind as an ADDITIVE feature helps (UD signature+kind 0.67 vs 0.59 each; ant-shape +0.055 in 11/11 languages) but per-kind models do not (-0.014). effect field: structure rule, AUC not defined; 0.5 is a placeholder (the number that matters is transfer ARI 0.474 vs 0.09).
passIf: On fresh IRC days or a third novel with a stricter null (shuffled-company partitions compared at the SAME K, K <= 12): held-out transfer ARI >= 0.40 vs shuffled <= 0.15, NMI vs frequency <= 0.30, and the same-K gap >= 0.10 for some K <= 12.
failIf: Held-out transfer ARI within 0.10 of its shuffled null, or NMI vs frequency > 0.5, or a persons-only kind appears (which would overturn the 'persons share the subject kind' reading).

statement: If the text is source code (JavaScript, Python, Ruby) and tokens are matched on position, frequency, length and first-in-line status, then user-bound identifiers differ from keywords, externals and literals by neighbour DIVERSITY: an identifier's current left or right neighbour matches its earlier ones less often (sameLeft AUC 0.37-0.41, sameRight 0.39-0.43, below 0.5 in all three languages), and the reader's 8-d company-structure arm separates them at 0.56-0.65 (later) and 0.65-0.71 (first occurrence, causal).
scope: 12 JS files, 12 Python stdlib files, 8 Ruby files (parser gold: acorn, ast/tokenize, Ripper; balance-gated matched negatives from E=externals, K=keywords, L=literals), leave-one-file-out; the first occurrence of an identifier is NOT deaf in code (causal FIRST AUC 0.56/0.65/0.63 for the full record).
outOfScope: Fitted counting rivals beat the ablation record (rivals 0.73/0.78/0.73 vs full record 0.553/0.628/0.607, FULL minus best rival -0.18/-0.15/-0.13), so the shape is company diversity in disguise, not an ablation signal. Does not transfer to treebank PROPN (code to UD 0.50-0.54) and is REVERSED on chat nicknames (code to IRC record AUC 0.33-0.41, significantly below chance, where nicknames repeat the same left neighbour: sameLeft 0.859). Code-language transfer is weak (JS to PY company-structure 0.604, PY to JS 0.587; full record 0.565/0.535). Paired joint ablation: the identifier hole differs from a frequency-matched non-identifier hole (p 0.0002 in JS and PY) but cosine 0.99, and amplification flips sign between languages (JS 1.73 vs 1.30, PY 1.63 vs 1.69). Ruby was exploratory.
observables: Left/right neighbour diversity inside the causal window (distinct neighbours over mentions; share of earlier mentions with the same left/right neighbour) and the reader's 8-d company-structure features (the 'C' arm of the impact record, not the rank-bin probe of COMPANY-LATER-BOTH); token form lowercase with non-alphanumerics mapped to z. No keyword list, no capitals, no POS.
discovery: ant-code results/*-np-PA.json, *-FIRST.json, transfer.json, summary.txt (no REPORT.md was written; summary read from files). PA (primary, 623/808 JS, 212/217 PY, 505/676 RB pos/neg): full record 0.5533 [0.523, 0.579] / 0.6283 / 0.6066 vs fitted rivals 0.7318 / 0.7793 / 0.7324; company-structure arm 0.6434 / 0.6462 / 0.5597; sameLeft 0.4125 / 0.3592 / 0.3741, sameRight 0.3908 / 0.3816 / 0.4313 (raw direction, identifier positive). FIRST (188/55/263 pairs, causal): company 0.6525 / 0.7112 / 0.6533 vs rivals 0.6931 / 0.6957 / 0.6588, full 0.563 / 0.648 / 0.632. Within-unit word shuffle takes the company-structure arm to 0.553 / 0.476 / 0.536. Balance gates passed (|SMD| <= 0.10, covariate AUC in [0.44, 0.56]); sham 100% null; determinism 218/218 JS, 238/238 PY. effect = JS company-structure arm at PA. Leave-one-FILE-out inside the same 12 files per language; no fresh files (the cross-language transfer test is the nearest thing).
passIf: On 12 further code files per language (hash-order rule fixed in advance) the company-structure arm >= 0.58 at PA in JS and PY, sameLeft and sameRight AUC both < 0.45, and the within-unit shuffle takes that arm below 0.55.
failIf: Company-structure arm < 0.54 or sameLeft/sameRight AUC >= 0.48 in either language, or the shuffled arm stays >= 0.58 (then it is counts).

statement: If a word has arrived at least twice and the RECEIVED PRIOR nominates it as a name (never met it, or tallies PROPN/X >= 0.5), then it exists as a being at the structural floor without a keyness test, while any other word the prior has met must still be key against its received rate; expected gain over the 5% keyness gate: PROPN macro F1 about +0.056 to +0.064 on fresh treebank folds (22 and 19 of 25 stems up), up to +0.25.
scope: 25 UD stems, caseless-script and cased alike (caseless mean +0.067, cased +0.056); recurring PROPN gold (>= 2 in a block), exact string match, text case-stripped; folds A (last 20%) and B (first 20%) of every TRAIN treebank with ALL priors rebuilt without them. Largest where the old gate was removing real names: por +0.252, hin +0.163, ind +0.143, spa +0.127, fra +0.115, deu +0.114, fas +0.108, cmn +0.098, urd +0.086, jpn +0.056 (S >= 0.05 on both folds: spa cmn cmn-hans fas jpn fra por hin ind urd).
outOfScope: Effect <= 0.02 on both folds: arb kor (gold names ~0, unmeasured), pol ukr swe tur ell fin. Requires a received POS prior (observable is PRIOR-BASED, so it violates the format-free rule; listed because it is shipped). The cast is NOT wired into the production reading path (production uses heardNominals), so the gain is an eval-level result. Folds are slices of the TRAIN treebanks (same domain): nothing about domain shift. Salience as a rank does NOT order names (AUC 0.447 DEV, 0.416 fold A, 0.448 fold B, below 0.5 in 18 of 23-25 stems). A name seen once is still not admitted here (floor 2).
observables: Arrival counts of the form in the material; the prior's tally for the form (PROPN/X share, or never met); the binomial tail against the received rate for words the prior has met.
discovery: beings-ladder-results/{s4,t1,t2} (recomputed in verify-beings.json, 23 of 26 checks reproduce, the other three are threshold or stage-label differences explained in RULEBOOK.json nonReproducedExplained). Old (000) to new (111) macro F1: fold A 0.3377 -> 0.4151 (+0.0774; 23 up / 0 down / 2 flat), fold B 0.3113 -> 0.3778 (+0.0665; 21 up / 1-2 down / 2-3 flat), DEV 0.346 -> 0.417. S main effect +0.0636 / +0.0556 (fold A / B; up in 22 / 19 stems, down in 0 / 1 (vie, borderline), flat in 3 / 5 (arb kor tur; arb kor swe tur ell)), DEV +0.0486 (designed on DEV, optimistic). S profile is a stable property of a language: fold A vs fold B Spearman 0.87. Rules add: effect of S with A on minus off +0.0033, with R -0.0003 (n=75). Pre-registered PS1 (>= 18 of 25 stems) failed (15) and led to S-prime then S-double-prime; the final form was confirmed on the two folds. effect = probability that S helps in a random stem (fold B: 19 up + 0.5 x 5 flat of 25, 1 down = 0.86); fold A is 0.94 (22 up, 3 flat).
passIf: On a fresh slice of a new treebank domain (priors rebuilt without it): S main effect >= +0.03 mean F1 with >= 15 of 25 stems up and <= 2 down.
failIf: Mean S effect < +0.01 or more than 5 stems down by > 0.02.

statement: If the language writes fused or apostrophe-bound surfaces (del, don't, l', dell'italia, 's, host-guarded suffixes), then splitting them with a contraction prior derived by simulating each rule on the treebank (kept only if right at least half the times it fires) raises PROPN F1 by about +0.012 on average, up to +0.097 (ita), and by exactly 0 where there is no contraction file.
scope: The 13 stems with priors/contractions-<stem>.json (deu ell eng fas fin fra ind ita pol por spa tur ukr); effect >= 0.01 on both folds in eng fra deu ita por ind ell; fold A effects ita +0.097, fra +0.081, ell +0.041, deu +0.026, eng +0.020, ind +0.016, por +0.013. A is the only one of the three beings rules wired into production (ear.js).
outOfScope: Priors are treebank-derived (PRIOR-BASED). heb proclitic ear false-splits 14-15% of plain words and arb 2.4-2.6% (defect surfaced, not fixed); tur split-recall 0.35-0.51 (agglutinative languages need their own affix priors; fin hun too); ukr hin urd swe nld have almost no surface splits. A DERANGED contraction prior still raised F1 in 7 stems (ita +0.15, ell +0.04, deu +0.02: PA4 failed), so the surface list alone carries part of the gain in ita. The instrument R1 (hear words) still says ear_inert for spa fra deu ita por ind tur ell. Same-domain folds only.
observables: The treebank-derived list of whole-surface splits and apostrophe-bound affix rules applied to the raw word stream before counting.
discovery: beings-ladder-results t1/t2/s4 (verify-beings.json). A main effect +0.0126 (fold A) / +0.0120 (fold B) / +0.0192 (DEV); among the 13 stems with a file: up 10 / 9 stems, down 0 / 0, mean +0.0242 / +0.0232; the 12 stems without: exactly 0.000 in every one. Split recall (on): fra 0.995/0.999, deu 0.999/0.997, ita 0.985/0.968, por 0.986/0.992, ell 1.00, spa 0.962/0.942, eng 0.834 (fold A; misses are typos 'its = it 's') / 0.958 (fold B), false-split <= 0.0063 (fra). Profile stability fold A vs fold B Spearman 0.987; correlation with contraction density 0.885. effect = probability of superiority among the 13 stems with a file (fold B: 9 up + 0.5 x 4 flat of 13; fold A 0.885).
passIf: On a fresh treebank domain: mean A effect >= +0.01 over stems with a file, 0 stems down by > 0.01, exactly 0 where no file exists.
failIf: Mean A effect < +0.005, or any no-file stem changes (the control built to fail), or split false-positive rate > 1% in a stem that has a file.
